Exact rational evaluation reuses AngouriMath 2.5.0 (MIT) and its explicitly pinned dependencies: Antlr4.Runtime.Standard 4.13.1 (BSD-3-Clause), GenericTensor 1.0.4 (MIT), HonkSharp 1.0.3 (MIT), PeterO.Numbers 1.8.0 (public-domain/CC0-1.0). Complete upstream licence files are included; GenericTensor LICENSE is the exact published package file. The CSharpMath parser and its existing notices/font licences remain supplied by the existing Home NativeUI dependency. No modified maintained-library implementation is distributed.
